purpose: Measure how the recorded Phase 3 screening procedure behaves when documentation is deliberately removed: whether it abstains instead of inventing values, how much of the tie-inclusive shortlist survives, and how much missing facilities inflate the remaining sites. This is not evidence of real-world accuracy.

production_origin_loss.unit: fraction of development reporting regions with known production
production_origin_loss.effect: known modeled tonnes become UNKNOWN with an explicit missing reason

location_unknown.effect: reporting-region spatial match becomes unmatched; the facility stays listed

facility_undocumented.effect: facility, node, capacity, source row and spatial matches are removed together

abstention_rule: A node may be ranked only when its location match, stationary-service eligibility and reporting-region production are all known. Otherwise it is reported UNKNOWN with a reason, never ranked or treated as zero.
